svg.text: L2 · IO-PWR — Checklist jalur PCB (pad → pad)
Board industrial locked Fase 1 · fokus clearances AC vs DC
A. AC HEATER (lebar track / clearance besar)
☐ F4 → F1 → K1 A1/A2 → SSR1 LOAD → J5.1 (L heater)
☐ N mains → J5.2 / bar N (sesuai desain)
☐ Separation AC vs 12V logic ≥ clearance KiCad rules
☐ Q_K1 gate ← HEATER_EN (J9.5) via R_G1 · pulldown R_G2
☐ D_K1 flyback coil · SSR CTRL dari node coil
JANGAN lempar EMI di jalur heater — EMI hanya cabang PSU
Heatsink SSR + thermal pad wajib di BOM
B. PSU 12V
☐ AC → EMI1 → PSU1 L/N/PE
☐ PSU +12V → F3 → +12V_BUS ke beban + J9.1
☐ PSU GND → GND · J_PE ← PE
☐ F2 di cabang PSU AC sesuai schematic
☐ J9.1 harus continuous ke MAIN U3 VIN
FG / PE bonding < 0.1 Ω di assembly
E-Stop NC#1 memutus AC PSU di harness H3 (bukan di PCB saja)
C. DC LOADS
☐ J9.6 DRUM_EN → U20 → Q2 → J6 (F_DRUM, D2)
☐ J9.7 COOL_EN → Q7 → Q3 gate → J7
☐ J9.8 EXHAUST_PWM → Q4 gate → J8
☐ Pulldown gate R_Q3_G / R_Q4_G ke GND (boot safe OFF)
☐ Flyback D3/D4 dekat MOSFET
Terminal J6/J7/J8 di tepi field wiring
D. J9 PIN MAP (IO side)
1 +12V_BUS out ke MAIN · 2 GND · 4 GND_SIG
5 HEATER_EN in · 6 DRUM_EN in
7 COOL_EN in · 8 EXHAUST_PWM in
9 +5V sense in (opsional) · 3/10–20 NC/spare
Place J9 mirror ke MAIN supaya ribbon pendek lurus
Silk J9 pin1 tanda segitiga wajib (junior assembly)
E. Urutan layout IO
AC/heater kiri-atas → PSU tengah → K1/SSR kanan → DC loads bawah → J9 tepi ke MAIN
DRC: clearance HV, hole, edge · lalu Gerber IO (Fase 1 tidak diganti ke modul)
Ref: D01E_Heater_Control_v3.6.md · gen_pcb_layout.py IO_*_LINKS · pcb_nets.py
IO lebih “sudah industrial” — prioritas junior: clearances AC + J9 pin1 ke MAIN FIXED 5V
